mechanism.hypothesis: A gravity driven upstream reservoir overflowing a finite height internal crest into a downstream receiver produces a boundary and transfer mechanism that is independent of rotating cup duration and suspended obstacle contact.
mechanism.physical_question: Does a closed outer tank with a fixed internal crest produce a reproducible reservoir to receiver transfer event when crest height is varied over a preregistered range?
scientific_difference: The fluid is initially continuous and stationary in an upstream reservoir; there is no prescribed cup motion or source impulse.
The internal finite height weir creates a true crest crossing and downstream receiver basin within one closed outer tank.
The only q dependent physical parameter is crest height; duration, horizon, observer and outer tank remain fixed.
Native mDBC Boundary=2 with generated normals is used on the outer tank and weir shell; this boundary/topology combination is new for this scope.
disallowed_shortcuts_not_used: no rotating cup or DBC duration reuse
no F5 wave or runup source recipe
no horizon extension before a complete hard pass
no survivor renormalization or point diagnostic credit

downstream_receiver.containment: outer tank floor and side walls; top open

boundary_and_numerics.normal_generation: GeometryForNormals with distanceh=3, svshapes=true, explicit invert contract

registered_window.extension_policy: one whole scope extension only after a complete hard pass; event censoring remains in the denominator

hard_integrity: native fluid IDs unique and no active fluid ID missing
zero closed outer-wall and weir endpoint violations
zero outer-wall or weir penetration particle frames
zero fluid particles outside the closed outer tank

event.crest_crossing: at least 1% of initial fluid mass crosses x=0.78 m above the crest plane
event.receiver_contact: at least 1% of initial fluid mass enters the downstream receiver region
event.completion: receiver contact is sustained for 0.20 s and a complete registered window is observed
event.credit_policy: hard pass and complete event are both required; CPU/native preflight and canary evidence have zero T1 credit

observer.event_censoring_policy: a hard pass without crest/receiver completion is event_censored and remains in the denominator

fixed_matrix.denominator_policy: all 15 rows remain in the denominator regardless of outcome

blockers: A read-only receiver/crest contract adapter now exists, but no solver-integrated runtime adapter or observer has received root review.
Only one CPU/native anchor input exists; the 15 solver rows are not materialized or executed.
No solver product, event result, qualification result or T1 registration exists.
Root review lock is required before any solver, GPU or queue action.
